_: Little Big Questions, deep-sea, a SILENT story (series grammar: no narration; the picture explains; music and real sound effects carry it; a few big words set in code). One fixed Fable view of one lifted slice: a tall cutaway column of ocean floating over the hole it was lifted from, the sunny sea carrying on all round. Facts and cautions: docs/research/KIDS_FACTS_2026-10.md section 2.3 (zones by NOAA depths, sunlight fades with depth, many animals the cameras see make their own light, only SOME anglerfish have a lure and its glow comes from bacteria, vents found in 1977 with life around them, very little of the deep seafloor has been seen, never 5 percent explored). Times in seconds, 70.5 s, timed to the music edit.

beats.name: hook
beats.picture: A sunny sea to the horizon with a boat, gulls, an island with a palm and a whale's spout. In front, a tall slice of ocean floats a little above the hole it was lifted from. On the top of the slice a rubber duck bobs next to a little round submarine; a snail peeks out of its porthole.
beats.words: WHAT LIVES IN THE DEEP SEA?
beats.sound: gentle waves, gulls, a far boat, the duck's squeak, the submarine's soft hum
beats.music: the rolling wave motif begins in the low strings (recording 0:00.5)

beats.name: sunlight zone
beats.picture: The submarine tips its nose down and dives through the surface with a ring of bubbles. The top water is bright turquoise with sun rays; a school of yellow fish turns around it, a turtle glides by.
beats.sound: a soft splash, bubbles, the fish school's flutter, a turtle's slow paddle
beats.music: the wave motif rises and falls, the dive (recording 0:06 to 0:14)

beats.name: twilight zone
beats.picture: The blue turns to dusk violet as the sun rays run out. Big-eyed silver fish glide past; on the music's swell a shoal of tiny lantern fish switch on their little lights and swirl round the submarine.
beats.sound: the water hums lower, a sparkle of tiny chimes as the lanterns light
beats.music: the first swell (recording 0:17 to 0:19.5): the lights come on

beats.name: midnight zone
beats.picture: Darkness. The submarine switches on its headlamp and its beam is the only light; specks of marine snow drift through it. For a held breath nothing glows at all.
beats.sound: the lamp's click, deep quiet, a slow bubble
beats.music: the sound thins out into a hush; the splice lands in the silence (recording 1:05 to 1:07)

beats.name: they glow
beats.picture: A soft light blooms below: a jellyfish lights up, then another, then a third, each a different colour, drifting like lanterns while tiny sparkles twinkle round them.
beats.sound: a glass-like chime for each jellyfish, water burble
beats.music: the warm cello theme begins (recording 1:08): the creature reveal

beats.name: glowing squid
beats.picture: A round little squid with polka dots of light and big eyes zips past, blinking its spots in a pattern; a message in a bottle drifts by. The submarine's snail waves at it.
beats.sound: a squeaky whoosh, a bubble pop, the bottle's cork bob
beats.music: the theme goes on, rising a little (recording 1:15 to 1:21.5)

beats.name: the lantern
beats.picture: A friendly round anglerfish with big kind eyes swims up with a glowing lure. The submarine's lamp blinks off; the fish swings its lure over the submarine and lights it up like a torch. The snail looks up and waves. Only some anglerfish have such a lure, so this one is shown as one friendly fish.
beats.sound: a cheerful little boing, a warm chime as the lure lights, a bubble giggle
beats.music: the theme answers itself, warmer (recording 1:21.5 to 1:28.5)

beats.name: hot vents
beats.picture: The submarine settles down to the seafloor. A hot vent shimmers; giant red tube worms sway round it, living without any sunlight. A toy boat lies in the sand, a lost sandal, a little treasure chest.
beats.sound: a low warm rumble, bubbling, soft sand thumps
beats.music: the build to the tutti (recording 1:28.5 to 1:37)

beats.name: all the lights
beats.picture: On the climax every light in the whole slice twinkles on at once, from the seafloor to the twilight, jellyfish, squid, lantern fish, the fish's lure, the vent, a deep sea of little lights.

beats.name: only a tiny piece
beats.picture: The lights go out one by one until the submarine's torch lights a tiny round patch of the wide dark seafloor. Its beam shows only a little: most of the seafloor has never been seen. The submarine rises.
beats.sound: the lights fading with soft chimes, a questioning bubble
beats.music: cross-fade to the piece's own closing section (recording 11:07.5): the tutti swells to the first final chord

beats.name: back to the surface
beats.picture: The submarine rises through twilight and sunlight and pops out of the sea at golden sunset; the snail waves, the boat sails home, a gull calls. Far below the slice keeps its tiny lights twinkling.
beats.sound: a gentle splash, gulls, calm waves, the duck's squeak
beats.music: the final cadence of the piece: two soft chords and the hush (recording 11:12 to 11:19.5)

words_rules: Set in code (Fable lettering, large, readable on a phone, 2.5 s minimum on screen); no em dash, en dash or three dots; never drawn by a model.
sound_rules: Music is the voice of the film: foreground, not a bed (about -16 LUFS integrated). Every event the picture shows has a real recorded sound (CC0 studio bank). Nothing harsh, sudden or scary: soft attacks, no loud stingers, true peak under -1.5 dBTP.
